```python
# filename: compute_first_two_atom_distance.py
from Bio.PDB import PDBParser
import numpy as np

pdb_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7dd30055-0198-452e-8c25-f73dbe27dcb8.pdb"
parser = PDBParser(QUIET=True)
structure = parser.get_structure("struct", pdb_path)

atoms = list(structure.get_atoms())  # Preserves file order

coord1 = atoms[0].get_coord()
coord2 = atoms[1].get_coord()

dist = np.linalg.norm(coord1 - coord2)
print(f"Distance between the first and second atoms: {dist:.3f} Å")
```
